source_discrepancies.decision: Seven Oran Berries for HGSS, matching Bulbapedia and the game script; Serebii Route 39 says five.
source_discrepancies.detail: The script consumes one Oran Berry per feed, sets flags 0A9, 0AC, 0AD, 0AE, 0AF, 0B0 on feeds 1–6, then healed flag 0AA on feed 7.

source_discrepancies.decision: Bulbapedia identifies the northeastern island; Serebii general description says southeastern. The guide uses northeastern and retains the independent Silver Wing/Tidal Bell checks.
Four floors (1F/B1F/B2F/B3F), supported by Bulbapedia and pinned map IDs; Serebii prose calls it three-levelled. Picking up HM07 is mandatory in HGSS; teaching/using it is not necessary to exit.

source_discrepancies.topic: Flash in Mt. Silver and Mt. Mortar
source_discrepancies.decision: Do not carry Generation II cave-darkness statements into HGSS. Both relevant HGSS cave descriptions explicitly distinguish the lit remakes.
Victory Road, Indigo Plateau, and Route 22 references explicitly use /4th/ pages, avoiding the default Let’s Go descriptions.
Canonical HGSS location name is Goldenrod Tunnel. Goldenrod Underground remains a searchable alias and source-site label.
